adaptations: Expand the official standard-PiPER gripper include.
Remove only the massless virtual gripper_link/gripper controller and both physical-finger mimic tags; command six rotary joints and two real finger joints through simulation PID.
Preserve all physical-link mass, center-of-mass and inertia tensors from the official model.
Use project-local mesh paths; add isolated Harmonic controllers, scene and estimated wrist camera mounting.

gripper.evidence: Official finger STL transformed by the official joint frames and limits; not a physical measurement.

physics_evidence.scope: Official prepared PiPER model before project camera/controller adaptation.
physics_evidence.mathematical_checks: 11 physical-link inertias positive definite and satisfy principal triangle inequalities; masses positive.
physics_evidence.calibration: No real PiPER mass/inertia calibration performed. All upstream values retained.
physics_evidence.known_boundary: Under the assumption that all link mass lies within its official STL AABB and the tensor is about the declared CoM, some link2/link3/link5 moments exceed a CoM/AABB bound. No unverified correction was applied.
physics_evidence.format_check: Prepared upstream URDF parsed by installed gz sdf -p; this does not prove a successful project grasp.

environment.origin: Existing D1-T photo workspace, including AMD KR260 and MINISFORUM/Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 exterior models.
environment.identity_boundary: Photo-derived positions and unmeasured dimensions remain approximations; CPU/FPGA performance is not emulated.

wrist_camera.scope: Retain the supplied T-bracket STL and existing simulated RGB camera exterior.
wrist_camera.mount: PiPER installation pose is a simulation estimate, not measured hand-eye calibration.
wrist_camera.image_source: Real Gazebo RGB sensor rendered in the simulated scene; not an image from hardware.

runtime.startup: Manual transient user units, no boot autostart.
runtime.hardware: No hardware command or hardware connection is part of this simulator.

project_validation.limitations: Fixed 40mm/20g cube, explicit reset between cycles, simulation contact patches and uncalibrated PID/camera mounting; not real hardware validation.

simulation_contact_patch.description: Two flat box contacts on the official gripping surfaces to stabilize finite contact patches in DART. Visual CAD and mass/inertia retained.

grasp_scope.placement_control: IK from observed payload-to-wrist transform and oriented cube extent; robot joints move, release 6mm above support; verify actual table contact and no finger contact.

current_validation.scope: Current 40mm / 20g cube, fixed-target simulation with explicit reset between cycles. Not hardware or precision-placement calibration.
